_readme: ART (2026-10-05, the art law feedback_art_not_diary): the watch's canned replay is a universal example anyone gets — three everyday things said into a watch, becoming one calendar add and two tasks. Never Jon's own memo. The memo name follows the real system's placeholder pattern (a word and a number), not a real capture.
transcript: Okay, brain dump. The dentist moved my cleaning to Thursday at two, put that on the calendar. I still need to return the library books, there's three of them and I think one is overdue, and renew the one about bread. And the lamp in the hall, it's the cord, not the bulb, so a new plug from the hardware store and I can fix it myself this weekend.

tickets.title: Fix the hall lamp
items: It's the cord, not the bulb
New plug from the hardware store
